name: Labelled H-box fusion
summary: An H-box with label a fuses with a standard H-box through an arity-2 H-box, keeping the label a.
description:
An H-box with an arbitrary complex label $a$ that is connected through an arity-2 H-box to a standard (label $-1$) H-box fuses with it into a single H-box with label $a$ and all the remaining legs. Note that only one of the two H-boxes may carry a non-standard label.

With $a = -1$ this is the phase-free [H-box fusion](../zh-h-box-fusion/) rule. A useful consequence is that H-boxes absorb $|1\rangle$ states, see [H-boxes absorb |1⟩](../zh-h-box-absorbs-one/).
parameter_notes: n legs on the first H-box and m on the second (shown for n = m = 2); holds for any number of legs.
notes: The H-boxes here are *unnormalised*: an H-box with label $a$ has all entries equal to $1$, except for the entry where all wires are $1$, which is $a$. The grey spiders of the ZH papers are normalised differently from the X-spiders of PyZX, so scalar factors may differ from those in the papers.
